blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable by keyboard) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-accessibility-2 (Icon-only delete control has no accessible name) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Render the delete action as a native `<button type="button" onClick={onDelete}>`, which is focusable, exposes the button role and reacts to Enter and Space (WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value). Keep a visible focus style on it (WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible).
findings.title: Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable by keyboard

findings.recommendation: Give the control a text name, e.g. `<button type="button" aria-label="Delete document">` or visually hidden text inside the button; `TrashIcon` renders an `aria-hidden="true"` svg, so it contributes no name (WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value).
findings.title: Icon-only delete control has no accessible name

findings.recommendation: Add an `alt` naming the owner (pass the owner's name as a prop, e.g. `alt={ownerName}`), or `alt=""` if the owner is identified in text elsewhere (WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content).
findings.title: Owner's avatar image has no alt attribute

findings.recommendation: Ensure the `.icon-button` target is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels (padding around the 16 by 16 icon) or has enough spacing (WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)).
findings.title: Delete target may be smaller than 24 by 24 CSS pixels
